# EmptyState

```ts
import { EmptyState } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

What a view shows when it has nothing to show — no items yet, no search results, a failed load, no permission, or nothing left to do. It names the situation, says why or what to try, and offers a way forward. Use it inside a card, panel, table body or page region; for a temporary message about an action, use Toast, and for an inline problem with a field, use the field's helper text.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `'first-use' \| 'no-results' \| 'error' \| 'no-access' \| 'success'` | `'first-use'` | Scenario (Figma type) — sets the icon circle's color and the default icon: first-use (nothing created yet), no-results (a search or filter found nothing), error (content failed to load), no-access (missing permission), success (nothing left to do). |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'lg'` | `'sm'` | sm for cards, panels and table bodies (48px circle, 16px title, sm buttons); lg for a page or large region (64px circle, 20px title). |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` | **required** | One-line title — what's going on, in plain words. |
| `description` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Optional sentence explaining why, or what to do next. |
| `icon` | `React.ReactNode \| null` | — | Replaces the scenario's default icon. Inherits the circle's icon color and size — don't color or size it. Pass null to hide the icon. |
| `primaryAction` | `EmptyStateAction` | — | The main way forward, rendered as a primary fill Button (rightmost). |
| `secondaryAction` | `EmptyStateAction` | — | An alternative, rendered as a secondary outline Button before the primary. |
| `headingLevel` | `2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6` | `3` | Heading element for the title; the visual size comes from size. |

Also accepts all `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'title'>` props.

## Usage

```tsx
<EmptyState title="Nothing here yet" description="Create your first item to get started." primaryAction={{ label: 'Create', onClick: create }} />
<EmptyState type="no-results" title="No results found" secondaryAction={{ label: 'Clear filters', onClick: clear }} />
<EmptyState type="error" title="Something went wrong" primaryAction={{ label: 'Try again', onClick: retry }} secondaryAction={{ label: 'Contact support', onClick: help }} />
<EmptyState type="no-access" title="You don't have access" primaryAction={{ label: 'Request access', onClick: request }} />
<EmptyState type="success" title="You're all caught up" />
<EmptyState size="lg" title="No devices yet" />
```

## Accessibility

- The title is a real heading (h3 by default — set headingLevel to fit the page), so screen-reader users find the state when they move by headings.
- The icon is decorative (aria-hidden); the title and description carry the meaning, so write them to stand alone.
- It isn't a live region. If an empty state replaces content after an action (e.g. a search), announce the result count elsewhere.
- Button labels name the outcome ("Request access", not "OK").

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Say what happened and what to do next | Show a bare "No data" |
| Offer one clear primary action | Offer several competing actions |
| Use no-results with a way to clear the search or filters | Leave people stuck with filters on |
| Keep titles short and specific | Blame the person ("You entered it wrong") |
